ceu: ✦ The opposition between the Sun and Mars

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and routine. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between friendships and romance. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your career and family. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and money. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between relationships and your image. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between romance and friendships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between family and your career. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between money and intimacy. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The opposition between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your image and relationships. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.
